title: Bok Choy Steamed Rice
description: A delicious rice with bok choy recipe that is easy to make. Chef John livens up plain steamed rice with bok choy, sesame oil, and soy sauce.

steps.text: Separate bok choy leaves from stems. Slice stems into 1-inch pieces; chop leaves.

Combine water, rice, and soy sauce in a pot; bring to a simmer, and stir in bok choy stems. Reduce heat to low, cover the pot with a lid, and cook until rice is almost cooked through, about 18 minutes.

Stir bok choy leaves, chili-garlic sauce, and sesame oil into rice mixture with a fork. Remove pot from heat, cover the pot with a lid, and let sit until rice is cooked through and bok choy leaves wilt, about 5 minutes more. Fluff with a fork and garnish with sesame seeds.

video.description: In this video, you’ll see how to make long grain rice with fresh chopped bok choy. You’ll cook chopped stocks of bok choy directly in the pot, adding the chopped leaves at the very end, along with a splash of sesame oil and a little chili sauce. This tasty technique makes simple rice more interesting and delicious. Enjoy it with grilled or roasted meats.
